title: fix(plugins)!: a failed business-unit hierarchy read refuses instead of answering nobody, and a unit keeps every child unit past 1,000

Skills-docs: updated here. `content/docs/automation/approvals.mdx` now says a `department` entry also keeps its literal and logs the failed-read line when the `sys_business_unit` read of the unit or of its child units fails. No skill teaches what a failed business-unit hierarchy read answers.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：共享规则与审批的「业务单元」展开里，读 `sys_business_unit` 本身（种子单元是否存在且启用、逐层读下级单元）失败时不再当作「没人」，而是明确报错，且失败结果不进本轮缓存；下级单元的读改为按 id 分页读完（每页 1,000），超过 1,000 个下级单元不再被截断。
- 为什么改：上一单（成员表）修完后，单元表这条路仍会把读失败吞成「没人」并缓存一整轮：业务单元结构一变，重算就把 `business_unit` / `unit_and_subordinates` 规则的授权全部收回；审批则记成「expanded to nobody」或悄悄派给缩水的名单。
- 风险与回滚：唯一「从有答案变成报错」的情形是 `sys_business_unit` 的读本身失败（原来答空），属收窄，标题带 `!`；表或对象不存在仍答无人；1,000 个下级以内仍是一次读、结果不变。队列文件未改动，其失败姿态（记一次日志、贡献 0 人）照旧。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/business-unit-graph.ts`（`seedIsUsable`、`readChildUnits`）、`packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/approval-service.ts`（`expandBusinessUnitUsers`、`readRowsToCompletion`）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-sharing exec vitest run src/business-unit-hierarchy-reads-complete.test.ts`，预期 9/9 通过（种子读失败报错且不缓存、下级读失败报错且不缓存、1,001 个下级单元全部在内、对象缺失仍答无人）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

The `sys_business_unit` reads behind the business-unit expansions now answer every unit or refuse, the shape the member reads (`sys_business_unit_member`) got in #29647, through the same walk.

- **plugin-sharing, `BusinessUnitGraphService`**
  - `seedIsUsable` reads the seed row through `readMembershipToCompletion` (the one `keysetWalk` the member reads share). A failed read throws; it used to answer `false`, which both widths cached as `[]` for the pass. A missing `sys_business_unit` (`isObjectAbsentError`) still answers `false`.
  - `descendants` reads each parent's child units through the new private `readChildUnits`, the same walk in pages of 1,000 (`CHILD_UNIT_PAGE_ROWS`, the bound the read always carried). A failed read throws before anything is cached; it used to answer `[]` for that parent. A parent with more than 1,000 active children keeps every child.
  - The per-pass cache: an absent or inactive seed is still cached as `[]`. A failed read throws before any `set`, so the next call on the same pass reads again.
- **plugin-approvals, `ApprovalService.expandBusinessUnitUsers`**
  - The seed check (`businessUnitIsLive`, unchanged, already throws) is no longer wrapped in a catch-all: absence answers `[]`, any other failure refuses with `[approvals] business unit 'ID' in organization 'ORG' could not be read: …`.
  - The child-unit descent reads through the new private `readRowsToCompletion`, factored out of `readHoldersToCompletion` (which now calls it), in pages of 1,000. The refusal sentence is the existing one, now in one helper `holderReadRefusal`.
  - The caller is unchanged: `resolveApproverSpec`'s directory catch turns the refusal into the literal slot plus the `could not be expanded — a directory or read-filter lookup failed` warning, as for a failed member read.
- No new export from any package index, no `packages/spec` change, `ownership-queue-service.ts` untouched (its `expandSpec` catch already turns a refused expansion into nobody plus one warning).

## Tests

Two new real-engine files (ObjectQL + SqlDriver over in-memory SQLite, shipped `SysBusinessUnit` / `SysBusinessUnitMember`), the pins the card asks for per site:

| Pin | sharing (`business-unit-hierarchy-reads-complete.test.ts`) | approvals (`business-unit-hierarchy-complete.integration.test.ts`) |
|:--|:--|:--|
| failed seed read | refuses on `expandUnitMembers`, `expandUsers`, `descendants`; not cached | refuses; the slot is the literal with the failed-read warning |
| failed descent read | refuses on `descendants` and `expandUsers`; not cached; the single-unit width is untouched | refuses; literal plus warning, not a shrunk slate |
| 1,001 child units | all 1,002 units and every member; 2 child reads (control: 999 children, 1 read) | every member on the slate; 2 child reads (control: 1 read) |
| absence | unregistered object and dropped table both answer `[]` | unregistered object answers `[]` with no failure warning; dropped table answers `[]` |

## Acceptance notes

- `headOf` (`business-unit-graph.ts`) still turns a failed `sys_business_unit` read into `null` and caches it for the pass. It is outside this card's sites (it names a department head, not a recipient set) and is noted, not filed.
- The descent stays one walk per unit (breadth-first, a read per parent), as before; only each parent's read is now complete.
- The content/docs line is outside the claim's file surface: one sentence in `content/docs/automation/approvals.mdx` beside the member-read sentence #29647 added, so the page does not describe the old answer.
